tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i gnas gsum dge ba gsum gyi don khrid byang chub lam bzang bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ tshogs gnyis sa gzhir rnam grol dpag bsam shing*/ /mtha' yas yon tan me tog 'bras bkra zhing*/ /phan bde'i grib bsil srid zhi'i dbyings kun khyab/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub ljon shing la phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam chos rin chen gter/ /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gzhung lam mthar phyin nas/ /rgyu 'bras bla med theg mchog snying po'i don/ /dge ba gsum gyi khrid yig gsal bar bya/ / de la phyi thun mong gi gzhi rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa thog mar dge ba'i khrid/ nang khyad par gyi 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bar du dge ba'i khrid/ gsang ba nges don snying po'i 'bras bu rdzogs pa chen po bla na med pa'i theg pa tha mar dge ba'i khrid dang gsum bzhugs pa las/ dang po la gnyis te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ nyams su blang ba'i gdams khrid do/ /dang po la theg pa chen po'i gzhung lam so so la ltos nas bdag gis thos pa'i rim pa mang yang*/ gdams ngag gi gnas nges pa gsum du bsdu bas/ bstan pa la rim gyis bslab pa rgya chen spyod pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ sa lam ting nge 'dzin drod tshad bstan pa zab cing rgya che ba'i brgyud pa dang*/ chos nyidadon gyi gnas lugs bstan pa zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ thub pa chen po/ 'jam dpal/ zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri/ ma hā shrī/ rat+na/ bha ba badz+ra/ dharma kīrti/ dī paṃ ka ra/ su ma ti/ lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab/ tshe spong ba chos kyi bla ma/ phya pa chos kyi seng ge /dan 'bag pa dar ma bkra shis/ shes rab blo gros/ shes rab dbang phyug /sangs rgyas brtson 'grus/ dben dge ba shākya seng ge /bla brang ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ bsam yas pa tshul khrims blau gros/ gnyis pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ rnam par snang mdzad bzang po/ seng ge bzang po/

sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ gu na mi tra/ rat+na parba thā/ 'bum phrag gsum pa/ blau ldan shes rab/ 'bre shes rab 'bar/ ar byang chub ye shes/ khu shes rab brtson 'grus/ dkar chung ring mo ba/ zhang g.ye pa/ gnyal zhig /rgya phying ru pa/ chu mig pa seng ge dpal/ blau grags pa/ de la btsan dgon pa dang*/ dben dge ba gnyis/ de gnyis la bla brang pa dang*/ chos grags gnyis pos/ de gnyis la bdag gis thug go / gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug /ku sā li pa che ba/ chung ba/ jo bo rje/ bal po thang pa dza/ a bh+yā ka ra/ byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan/ gro lung pa chen po/ spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ rma shākya seng ge /mchims nam mkha' grags/ mkhan po smon tshul/ slob dpon byang chub grub/ slob dpon gzhon nu rdo rje/ des bsam yas pa ngag gi dbang po la'o/ /gzhan yang jo bo bka' rgyud kyi brgyud pa'ang yod de ma bris so/ /yon tan rang bzhin bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /bkra shis mchog gi lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin phan bde'i sprin tshogs can/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ / don gnyis nyams su blang ba'i gdams khrid la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba/ tshe mi rtag pa/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal/ las rgyu 'bras/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa/ skyabs su 'gro ba/ tshad med bzhi/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa bslab bya dang bcas pa ste rdo rje'i gnas brgyad las/ dang po la bcu ste/ ngo bo dal ba bsam pa/ khyad par 'byor pa bsam pa/ ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa bsam pa*/ thob dka'i dpe la bsam pa/ rim pa'i rnam dbye bsam pa/ don med chud zos bsam pa/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel bsam pa/ skye shi'i 'khor mo bsam pa/ dal 'byor bsngags pa bsam pa/ spro dga' mchog tu bsam pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mi khoms pa'i gnas brgyad bsam pa ste/ rang nyid der ma ltung bas kyang dal ba thob pa la dga' ba bskyed de chos bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o/

/de'ang dmyal bar skyes na tsha grang gi sdug bsngal la spyod spyod nas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ yi dwags su skyes na bkres skom gyi me 'bar bas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ dud 'gror skyes na gcig la gcig za la sogs pas 'tshe bas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ lha tshe ring por skyes na 'du shes med pa'i ngang du bskal par 'byams nas 'chi khar log par lta bas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ yul mtha' 'khob tu skyes na bstan pa'i snang ba med pas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ mu stegs byed la sogs par skyes na log par lta bas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ mun pa'i bskal pa la skyes na dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra mi grags pas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med/ lkugs par skyes na yid kyi dbang po snod du ma rung bas chos sgrub pa'i gnas med do/ /de bas na brgyad po der da ltar bdag ma skyes pas khom pa zhes bya ste/ chos sgrub pa la brtson par bya snyam pa ste/ de'ang skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ mi khom pa brgyad dang de las log pa dal ba thob pa'i rang bzhin la bsam ste chos kho na bya snyam pa yang nas yang du bsams la/ rjes dge ba bsngo zhing spyod lam thams cad du yang de ltar bsam pa la sbyar ro/ / khrid rkang dang po'o/ / de nas khyad par 'byor pa bsam pa ni/ mi'i lus ma thob na chos byar med pa las/ mir skyes pas kyang rang nyid 'byor pa dang*/ yul phyogs chos med par skyes na'ang chos spyod du med pa las/ chos dar ba ni don gyi yul dbus su skyes pas kyang rang nyid 'byor pa dang*/ dbang po ma tshang na'ang chos byar med pa las/ dbang po'i sgo tshang bas kyang rang nyid 'byor pa dang*/ las kyi mtha' log nas rtag tu mi dge ba la spyod na'ang chos byar med pa las/ las kyi mtha' ma log par dge ba la mos pas kyang rang nyid 'byor pa dang*/ bstan pa la ma dad na'ang chos spyad du med pa las/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad pas kyang rang nyid 'byor ba ste lnga tshang la/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du ma byon na chos kyi mig med pa las/ da res sangs rgyas byon pas kyang gzhan 'byor dam pa tshang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas byon yang chos ma gsungs na phan med pa las/ chos kyi 'khor lo gsum du bskor bas kyang gzhan 'byor dam pa tshang ba dang*/ chos gsungs kyang bstan pa mi gnas na phan med pa las/ da lta bstan pa ma nub tsam du yod pas kyang gzhan 'byor dam pa tshang ba dang*/ bstan pa gnas kyar ma zhug na phan med pa las/ bstan pa la zhugs pas kyang gzhan 'byor tshang ba dang*/ zhugs kyang mthun rkyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na blang dor gyi gnas mi shes pa las/ yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi snying brtse ba lhag pa'i thugs rjes yongs su 'dzin mkhan yod pas kyang gzhan 'byor dam pa lnga tshang ba ste/ da res 'byor pa'i sum tshogs pa bcu rang gi steng du legs par tshang ba'i skabs 'dir snying nas dal 'byor don yod par bya snyam pa ste/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi 'byor pa'i rgyu mtshan bsam pa/ rjes bsngo ba dang spyod lam rnal 'byor du bya'o/ / khrid rkang gnyis pa'o/ / de nas ngan 'gro'i g.yang sa bsam pa ni/ da res dal 'byor thob pa'i rten la dam pa'i chos shig ma bsgrubs na las kyi dbang gis shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song gsum du skyes dus kyi sgra yang mi thos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang yang mi mjal/ dge sdig gi ngo yang mi shes/ gang ci byed thams cad sdig pa ma gtogs pa dge ba med pas/ rtag tu 'khor ba na 'khor ba 'di mtshang re che na ang snyam pa ste sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug gi rim pa gsum gyis nyams su de ltar glang ngo*/ / khrid rkang gsum pa'o/ / de nas thob dka'i dpe la bsam pa ni/ rgya mtsho chen po rlung gis bskyod pa'i steng na gnya' shing bu ga gcig pa/ gcig tu mi gnas par chu'i rlabs kyis 'khyer ba dang chu'i 'og na rus sbal zhar ba lo brgya brgya na steng du lan cig 'ong ba de 'dzom nas/

gnya' shing gi bug par rus sbal gyi mgrin pa tshud pa bas/ ngan song las mi lus thob pa dka' ba dang*/ gyang gi zhal ba 'jal po la sran ma spar gang gtor na gcig tsam chags pa yang dka' bas mi lus thob dka' ba bsam ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ khrid rkang bzhi pa'o/ /de rim pa'i rnam dbye bsam pa ni/ spyir sems can tsam gyi rim pa dang grangs la bsams na mi lus thob pa srid pa tsam la/ mi la'ang chos med pa rtag tu sdig pa la spyod pa rnams la bsams na/ chos la mos pa dang chos thos pa srid pa tsam ste/ de las kyang snying nas yang dag pa'i chos kyi sgor zhugs pa dang spyod pa srid pa tsam la bsams te/ yang dag pa'i bla ma dang mjal/ zab mo'i chos thos/ thar pa'i lam la bslab tu yod pa mi lus rin po che thob pa 'di la 'bad dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang lnga pa'o/ / de nas don med chud zos bsam pa ni/ nor bu'i gling du phyin nas stong par log na rgya mtshor phyin pa don med pa ltar/ da res mi lus rin po che'i gling du phyin nas/ dam pa'i chos kyi nor sna re ma blangs/ thar pa'i lam sna ma zin/ tshe 'di'i bya bas g.yengs na mi lus rin po che thob kyang stong log byas pa yin snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang zhing dal 'byor bsam pa'o/ / khrid rkang drug pa'o/ / de nas rgyu rkyen rten 'brel bsam pa ni/ dam chos sgrub pa sems la rag cing sems de dal 'byor gyi lus la brten nas/ mthun pa'i rten 'brel tshogs pa'ang dka' la/ nad med pa dang sdug bsngal gyis ma gzir ba dang*/ gzhan dbang du ma gyur pa dang*/ rang dbang thob pa'i rten la ci nas kyang chos la 'bad dgos snyam pa/ sbyor ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas rting yang dang yang du snying nas dung dung bsgom la rjes bsngo ba dang spyod lam rnal 'byor du bya'o/

/ khrid rkang bdun pa'o/ / de nas skye shi'i 'khor lo bsam pa ni/ 'dir ltar sems can thams cad khams gsum rigs drug na skye shi'i kha brgyud/ so so'i sdug bsngal la spyod kyang*/ da dung dus 'di tsam na/ thar bya'i mtha' med pas/ dal 'byor thob dus chud gsan cing chos la ma spyad pas lan par 'dug /bdag gis dal 'byor don yod par bya snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang brgyad pa'o/ / de nas dal 'byor gyi bsngags pa bsam pa ni/ nyan rang gi dgra bcom dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang dal 'byor gyi rten las thob cing*/ gsang sngags kyi chos rlabs po che'ang dal 'byor kho na las 'grub la/ theg pa che chung gi chos thams cad kyi rten dal 'byor 'phags par gsungs pa'i phyir/ bdag gis kyang da res thar pa'i lam sna dal 'byor 'di las zin par bya dgos snyom du sbyor ba sems bskyed nas yang dang yang du bsam zhing rjes bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang dgu pa'o/ / de nas spro dga' mchog tu bsam pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ phongs pas nor bu rnyed pa'i dga' ba ltar/ rang gi dal 'byor rnyed pa la lta zhing rmi lam yin nam/ nges par bden nam snyam du spro dga' chen po bskyed de/ da res dam pa'i chos sgrub snyam pa yang nas yang du bya zhing rjes bsngo ba dang spyod lam gyi rnam 'byor du bya'o/ / khrid rkang bcu pa'o/ / don gnyis pa tshe mi rtag pa bsam pa la bcu gnyis te/ rten phung po la bsams te mi rtag pa/ skye dgu'i bdag po la bsams te mi rtag pa/ snod bcud chags 'jig la bsams te mi rtag pa/ dam pa'i skye bo la bsams te mi rtag pa/ nam 'chi nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa/ 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin la bsams te mi rtag pa/ 'chi rkyen drag po la bsams te mi rtag pa/ gcig pur 'gro ba la bsams te mi rtag pa/ dus kyi skye bo la bsams te mi rtag pa/

yid rten med pa la bsams te mi rtag pa/ rkyen snang nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa/ 'dun pa drag po la bsams te mi rtag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang dang gzhan gy-i lus yan lag dang nying lag tu tshogs pa la bltas te/ da lta mthun pa'i zas gos bsten/ rgyan dang byi dor byas kyang*/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus su gcer bu gos dang bral/ sa phyogs stong par bskyal/ wa dang bya rgod kyis za/ yan lag dang nying lag 'bral/ rus pa'ang dum bu tha dad du 'gro ba'i gnas yod skabs yod na/ de bas na da lta nyid du dam pa'i chos spyod dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bcu gcig pa'o/ / de nas skye dgu'i bdag po la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'di ltar lha'i dbang po dang*/ brgya byin/ dbang phyug /khyab 'jug /drang srong chen po rgyas pa dang*/ grog mkhar ba la sogs pa gzugs bzang ba/ gzi brjid che ba/ tshe bskal par thub pa/ rig pa'i yon tan che ba/ spyan dang mngon shes mnga' ba/ rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa dag kyang 'chi ba'i skabs yod na/ bdag cag lta bu ci'i phyir mi 'chi/ de bas da lta dam pa'i chos sgrub snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / /khrid rkang bcu gnyis pa'o/ / de nas snod bcud chags 'jig la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'di ltar ri dang yul grus mtshon pa snod kyi 'jig rten skyes pa bud med kyis mtshon pa bcud kyi sems can thams cad bskal pa 'jig pa'i me mdun chu gcig gis zhig nas stongs pa'i skabs yod na/ bdag cag lta bu ci'i phyir mi mchi snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bcu gsum pa'o/ / de nas dam pa'i skye bo la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas rabs bdun 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ bar bar du rang sangs rgyas 'khor du tsam la sogs pa'ang snga phyir byon cing gshegs la/ de dag gi bstan pa dang bcas pa'ang dar ba dang nub pa'i rim pa mtha' yas na/

bdag cag lta bu nye 'khor dang bcas pa la rtag pa ga la yod/ de'i phyir da lta nyid nas dam pa'i chos sgrub snyam du 'dun pa drag pos sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bcu bzhi pa'o/ / de nas nam 'chi nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ tshe la snon pa ni med/ 'brid pa ni nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig gis nyer song ste/ byi ba dkar nag gi rtsa thag gi nyag ma gcod pa dang 'dra/ gar 'chi cha med la 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bas nam 'chi'i snyam pa ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkag bcu lnga pa'o/ / de nas 'dus byas kyi rang bzhin la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ spyir 'dus byas kyi chos mi rtag /sgos su skyes bu'i tshe mi rtag /khyad par lus sems tshogs pa'i rten mi rtag ste/ sngaun dar zhing rgyas pa'i grong khyer dang*/ sde dgon zhig ral stongs pa'i dpes/ rang gi lus grong lta bu/ sems mi lta bu nam stongs pa'i skabs yong ngam snyam du snying nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bar nyams su blang ngo*/ /

khrid rkang bcu drug pa'o/ / de nas 'chi rkyen la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ mar me 'bar ba ni myur du 'dzad pas mi rtag pa la glo bur du rlung gis btab na skad cig gis 'chi ba ltar/ skyes nas 'chi bar phyogs pa la/ glo bur du nad dam gdon nam 'tshe ba drag pos dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rkyen byung na skad cig kyang gnas dbang med pa'i phyir/ bdag la'ang de lta bu nam 'byung cha med snyam du/ sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi de nyid kho na la bsams pa/ 'jug bsngo ba gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bcu bdun pa'o/ / de nas gcig pu 'gro ba la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'jig rten 'di'i snang ba ni 'dor/ phyi ma'i lam du ni zhugs/ mal gyi tha mar nyal/ zas dang gos kyi tha ma la spyod/ gtam gyi tha ma la smra ba'i tshe/ 'khor dang longs spyod dang*/ nye du 'brel pa la sogs pa thams cad bzhag nas gcig pur 'gro dgos pa'i dus shig 'byung ste/ shin tu bzod par dka'/ bdag la'ang de lta bu nam 'byung cha med snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bco brgyad pa'o/ / de nas dus kyi skye bo la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'di ltar lo brgya'i gong du 'das pa'i mi dang dud 'gro la sogs pa'i sems can yod pa kun da lta gcig kyang med la/ da lta sa steng gi sems can phal che'ang lo brgya'i 'og tu gcig kyang med par 'gyur la/ bdag kyang rang bzhin de las ma 'das shing*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyang de dang 'dra ste/ dus kyi lo thog brje ba ltar brnyings shing*/ sngon bdag gis btsas pa'i yul gyi nang mi khyim mtshes/ grogs gnyen 'dun/ sgo khyi ra phyugs/ dgra sdang ba na zla dang spun sring la sogs pa med pa la bsams te sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bcu dgu pa'o/ / de nas yid rten med par la bsam ste mi rtag pa ni/

ri'i zom/ rgya mtsho'i nang*/ bar snang gi khams la sogs pa sa phyogs dang 'dug sa ji lta bu na'ang 'chi bas mi tshugs pa gcig kyang med par/ dus dang dus ma yin pa'i rkyen gyis 'chi la/ khyad par du mi'i yul na 'chi rkyen gyi 'tshe ba shin tu mang ba'i phyir nam 'chi'am snyam du/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu pa'o/ / de nas rkyen snang nges med la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ 'chi rkyen glo bur ba med kyang nub ka'i grib so ltar 'chi bdag 'ong na/ dug dang*/ mtshon dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ dgra dang/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ tha na zas gos spyod lam nyes pas rkyen byas te 'chi ba shin tu mang bas/ bdag kyang nam 'chi'am snyam du snying thag pa nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o/ / de nas 'dun pa drag po la bsams te mi rtag pa ni/ gzhan du 'gro na da res 'chi'am gnas 'dir e log cha med do snyam pa dang*/ lam du bzhugs pa dang ngal stegs la sdod na'ang 'dir 'chi'am snyam pa dang*/ gang na 'dug kyang da res 'dir 'chi'am snyam pa dang*/ za ba dang*/ 'chags pa dang*/ nyal ba la sogs pa spyod lam ci byed kyang 'jig rten 'di'i spyod lam gyi tha ma yin snyam du 'chi ba 'ba' zhig dung dung bsgoms te/ sngon 'gro sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi snying nas 'dun pa drag po/ rjes bsngo ba dang spyod lam rnam 'byor du bya'o/ khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ /don gsum pa 'khor ba sdug bsngal du bsam pa la gsum ste/ skyo shas spyir bskyed pa/ sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa/ da lta'i tshul la dpag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di ltar khams gsum 'khor ba na 'khyams pa'i sems can 'di dag mngon par skyo ste/ 'khor ba brgyud mar 'khor dus sems can thams cad gcig gis gcig gi pha ma gnyen 'dun mdza' bshes bar ma dgra sdang ba ma byas pa med la/

rang nyid grog spur gcig pur skyes pa'i mgo dang rkang lag bsdoms te gcig tu phung por byar yod na ri rab las ches mtho zhing*/ ngus pa'i mchi ma rgya mtsho bas lhag la/ 'dod pa'i phyir mgo dang yan lag bcad pa'ang grangs med cing*/ tshe 'dir phyug cing 'byor pa 'khor dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa yang*/ shi nas dbul zhing phongs pa'i gnas su skye ba ni rmi lam gyi bde skyid gnyid sad nas med pa lta bu ste/ tshe 'di'i snang ba la rang gzhan chags shing skyid par snang ba'ang ngang tshul de las ma 'das pa'i phyir gang gis kyang ci bya/ 'di bas phyi ma rgyun ring bas thar pa'i chos la gnas par bya'o snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o/ / de nas sdug bsngal bye brag tu bsam pa la drug las/ dmyal ba'ang tsha dmyal brgyad kyi sdug bsngal ni/ yang sos ni/ mdag me 'bar ba'i yul khams su dmyal ba pa kun 'dus nas/ dgra bo mi sha bo gcig gis gcig mthong ba ltar phan tshun las kyi mtshon chas gsod res byas te shi ma thag yang sos par gyur cig gi sgra nam mkha' la grags pas sos te/ yang 'chi yang sos pa la las ma zad bar du myong dgos pa'o/ /thig nag ni/ lus la gshin rje'i skyes bus thig btab pa'i steng la lcags kyi sog les gshog cing*/ gshags pa kun 'byar nas yang gshog pa'o/ /bsdus 'joms ni/ lcags kyi gtun ljongs su phye ma zhib mor 'thag cing yang sos la yang 'thag pa dang*/ brag ri rta dang*/ rnga mo la sogs pa 'dra ba'i bar du 'joms pa'o/ / ngu 'bod ni/ lcags zhun bskor bar 'tshod cing lus la me 'bar ba bas ngu zhing 'o dod 'bod pa'o/ /ngu 'bod chen po ni/ lcags khang nyis rim du bcug nas mes bsreg cing gshin rje'i me'i tho bas 'joms pa'o/ /tsha ba ni lcags zangs khol mar 'tshod cing nang lto nas me 'bar ba'o/ /rab tu tsha ba ni/ lcags khyim me 'bar bar bsreg cing mdung rtse gsum pas phrag pa gnyis dang spyi bo phug ste lcags leb kyis dkri ba'o/

/mnar med ni lcags khang me 'bar ba 'khor lhag pa bcu drug gis bskor ba'i nang du sngar gyi sdug bsngal thams cad myong zhing*/ me dang 'dres pas na smre sngags tsam 'don pa'o/ /de dag kyang tshor ba bdun 'gyur gyis rags pas sdug bsngal bdun 'gyur gyis che ba'o/ /de lta bu'i dmyal ba nas bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal yod pas/ da res der ma skyes pa zhig ci nas kyang bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ / de nas nye 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ nye 'khor ba ni/ mnar med kyi 'khor lhag pa bcu drug yin te/ phyogs bzhi na me ma mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ mtshon cha'i thang*/ thal tshan gyi chu bo rab med dang bzhi bzhi yod pa'o/ /de yang sngar mnar med kyi lcags khang du sdug bsngal che drags pa de myong ba'i las bsrabs pa dang phyogs bzhi'i sgo bye ba snyam pa las dmyal ba pa dag so so nas phyir 'thon ma thag /'obs bzang po grib ma can lta bu mthong nas zhugs pas/ mdag me 'bar ba'i nang du sha rus 'tshig pa'o/ /de las thar ba snyam byed nas chu klung 'bab pa'i nang du zhugs pa lta bu las/ ro myags kyi 'dam srin bu lcags kyi mchu can la sogs pas 'bigs shing sdug bsngal ba'o/ /de las 'thon nas thang nyams dga' bar phyin pa las/ spu grir song ste rkang pa bzhags pa na dum bur gshog /bteg pa na sos pa'o/ /de nas thar te nags tshal bzang po mthong sar phyin pa'i ral grir song nas rlung gis bskyod pas lus dum bur gcod cing sos pa'o/ /de nas song ba las ri'i rtse nas lhan cig 'dus pa'i skyes pa'am bud med de nyid rang la 'bod par mthong nas 'dzegs pa las/ lcags kyi thur mas lus 'bigs shing steng du sleb dus khwa dang bya rgod kyis klad pa 'bru la/ ri'i 'dab nas yang 'bod par mthong ste phyin pas thur mas gyen la 'bigs shing*/

sngar gyi yul de la 'khyud pas lcags kyi skyes pa'am bud med me 'bar bar song ste rab tu 'khyud cing bsregs la za bar byed do/ /de nas song ba na chu klung bzang po rgyang ma nas 'bab par mthong ste/ 'bog ma thag thal tshan sked nub tu tshud de sha rus tshig nas phyir bros pa las/ 'gram gnyis gshin rje'i skyes bus bsrung bar snang ba'o/ /de lta bu'i sdug bsngal sngar yang mang du myong bas/ da ni de nas nges par dbyung bar bya dgos snyam ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o/ / de nas grang dmyal brgyad kyi sdug bsngal ni/ gangs ri dang ka ba dang chab rom gyi khrod/ bu yug langs pas sbrebs pa'i gnas ni/ grang bas nyen pas lus la chur bur byung bas chu bur can dang*/ chu bur rdol nas rmar song bas chu bur rdol ba dang*/ so 'thams pas so tham tham pa dang*/ a chu chu'i smre sngags 'don pas a chu zer ba dang*/ kyi hud ces 'don pas kyi hud zer ba dang*/ ud+pal ltar bzhi tshal du gas pas ut+pal ltar gas pa dang*/ pad+ma ltar brgyad tshal du gas pas pad+ma ltar gas pa dang*/ pad+ma chen po ltar bcu drug gam sum cu rtsa gnyis su gas pas pad+ma chen po ltar gas pa'o/ / de ltar gas pa'i rma nang du srog chags phra mo zhugs nas za shing grang ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzad pa la spyod pa'i tshul la bsams te/ da res de 'dra'i gnas su ma skyes pa la dga' ba bsgoms te chos la 'bad dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o/ / de nas nyi tshe ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ brag gi nang du bcar ba dang*/ chab rom gy-i nang du 'khyags shing rengs pa dang*/ chu tshan gyi nang du 'tshod pa dang*/ dgun chu grang ma'i nang du nyen pa dang*/ me nang du tsha zhing bsregs pa dang*/ shing sdong po'i gzugs la bcad gtubs byas pa na/ yan lag nying lag chad pa'i sdug bsngal dang*/

phru ba dang*/ sgo dang*/ sab mo dang*/ ka ba dang*/ sgyed po dang thag pa la sogs pa rtag tu bkol zhing spyad pa'i gzugs su skyes nas las kyis so so'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' ba myong ba dang*/ lcags kyi khang par nyin mtshan cha re 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la spyod pa la sogs pa ste/ ri dang rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang*/ gangs dang chab rom la sogs pa mi yul dang thun mong dang gzhan na sdug bsngal du mas nyen pa la bsams te/ de lta bur ma skyes pa zhig bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o/ / de nas yi dgas kyi sdug bsngal ni/ phyi'i sgrib pa can lus rid cing yan lag phra ba/ bza' btung gi sgra mi thos shing rtag tu bkres skom gyis gdung ba/ gzhan gyis 'tshe zhing yid du mi 'ong ba rgya mtsho dang nags 'dab la sogs pa mthong yang mthong ma thag skam pa'o/ /nang gi sgrib pa can glo snying nas me 'bar ba/ kha sna nas du ba 'thul ba'o/ /sgos khur kyi sgrib pa can yi dgas re re'i lus la mang po gnas bcas te/ de'i khrag dang sha la za bar snang bas sdug bsngal ba'o/ /de lta bu'i gnas su ma skyes pa zhig bya dgos snyam du/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ / de nas dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal ni/ bying na gnas pa rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ gling bar gyi mun pa na chang dar ma'i sbang ma tsam yod de/ gcig gis gcig za zhing glan rmongs gti mug pa dang*/ kha 'thor pa lha mi'i gnas na'ang bya dang ri dgas la sogs pa yod de/ gsod pa dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ brdung ba dang*/ 'tshog pa dang*/ 'tshe bas nyen pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod do/ /de lta bur ma skyes pa zhig bya snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o/ / de nas mi'i sdug bsngal ni gsum dang brgyad kyis gdungs pa las/

sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal mdze thog tu phol byung ba lta bu dang*/ na ba dang tsha ba dang mi 'dod pa'i rigs gcig ma sangs par gcig brtsegs nas byung ba rnams dang*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bag ma blangs nas bro brdungs pas khang pa rdib nas nyams nyes byung ba lta bu dang*/ de lta bde ba de nyid de ma thag sdug bsngal du 'gyur bas gdung ba rnams dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dug zos pa'am gzhan la gnod pa bskyal ba lta bu phyis sdug bsngal 'du byed pas sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde bar byed pa'i rigs rnams te/ 'di lta bu'i sdug bsngal las da res thar bar bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang sum cu pa'o/ / de nas skye rgas na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi la bsam pa ni/ thog mar bar do dri za nye bar 'khor dang pha ma'i khu khrag gnyis 'dres pa la/ zhag bdun tshan bdun du mer mer po dang*/ nur nur po la sogs las lus chags shing*/ de nas gong du 'phel te ma'i lto ba na gnas dus/ dri nga ba dang*/ skyugs bro ba dang*/ 'khums pa dang*/ mas zas gos spyod lam nyes pa kun la/ me'i 'obs na 'dug pa ltar res 'ga' ha cang tsha ba dang*/ gangs dang chu'i nang du tshud pa ltar grang ba dang*/ ris non par ltar lji ba dang*/ g.yang la bskyur ba ltar nyam nga ba dang*/ mgo mjug ldog nas sprugs pa ltar shin tu sdug bsngal ba/ btsa' dus bsdus 'joms kyi dmyal ba ltar dar cig brgyal ba dang*/ lag pas reg dus sha 'ur spu gris reg pa ltar mi bzod pa dang*/ khrus byas pa na pags pa bshu ba ltar tsha ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ / de'i phyir gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/ skye ba'i 'khor ba zad pa zhig da res bya dgos snyam pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so gcig pa'o/ / de nas rgas pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ lus kyi stobs shor bas ldang 'dug dang sgul skyod dka'/

dbang po'i mdangs nyams pas mig 'grib/ rna ba mi gsang*/ dran pa mi gsal/ shes pa'i rtsal shor bas blo'i spro zhi zhing sems kyi khongs chud/ rtsa rlung gi 'phel bri bas byis pa bzhin col chung la tshor ba rags/ nang gi lus sems 'gyur bas nad dang 'tshe ba mang zhing kun gyi yid du mi 'ong*/ ngag tu 'chi ba la smon yang don la shi yis dogs pa la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med do/ /de phyir rga shi med pa'i byang chub cig da res 'grub par bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so gnyis pa'o/ / de nas na ba'i sdug bsngal la bsams te/ 'byung bzhi'i 'du ba 'khrugs pas zug gzer gyi tshor ba rags/ lus kyi rang bzhin 'gyur 'tshig cing yid mi bde/ dbang po'i stobs nyams pas mal nas ldang 'dug dka'/ gang yang yid du mi 'ong bas rtag tu 'du shes 'khrugs/ gdon bgegs bar chad langs pas glo bur ye 'drog che/ da res shi yis dogs pa'i sems kyi sdug bsngal che ba la sogs pa ste/ shin tu bzod par dka' ba'i rang bzhin la bsams te/ da res zug rngu thams cad las grol ba'i bdud rtsi thob par bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ /

khrid rkang so gsum pa'o/ / de nas 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ mal gyi tha mal na 'dug /zas gos kyi tha ma la spyod/ gtam gyi tha ma smra/ 'khor 'dab dang nye du 'brel pa mang pos bskor kyang phan pa ni cung zad med/ 'chi ba'i tshor bas gdungs/ 'khrul snang gi sun mas slebs/ bar do'i 'phrang la zhugs/ las kyi 'byung ba sdud/ tshe 'di'i snang ba 'dor/ phyi ma'i yul la snyegs/ thams cad bor nas gcig pur mar gyi gseb nas spu don pa ltar 'gro ba'i dus na/ zas nor ji tsam yod kyang zan chang cig khyer ba'i dbang yang med/ 'khor dang nye du ji tsam yod kyang mi gcig dang 'grogs dbang yang med par 'gro dgos pa 'di mtshang re che/ da res song nas ni phyir mi ldog /de la de snga phan chad tshe 'di'i snang ba dgra 'dul/ gnyen skyong/ gnas dang yo byad kyi phyi tshis/ bu tsha 'khor 'dab kyi sha tsha byas pa la don ci yod snyam du 'chi med thar pa'i lam mchog bsgrub pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khri rkang so bzhi pa'o/ / de nas mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal ni/ mi 'dod pa'i mi dang 'tshe dogs byung ba ste/ mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal zhing yid mi bde ba dang*/ sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ gnyen dang mdza' bshes shi ba dang*/ yul thag ring por song ba'i rjes lta bu ste/ de'i yon tan lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dran pa'i mod yid gdung zhing mngon par mi dga' ba dang*/ dngos po bzang dgu nyams pa dang*/ bsod nams 'gribs pa la sogs pa ste/ gang yid du 'thad pa bral bas mya ngan skye ba dang*/ gzugs dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa ste rang gi nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga po 'di yang*/ sdug bsngal gyi gnas dang rten dang 'byung khungs su gyur pas sdug bsngal te/ dper na tsher ma zhig zug na'ang*/ gzugs la na tsha'i zug rngu/ tshor ba sems kyi de nyid zug tu shes pa/

na tsha de nyid skad cig 'brel chags su 'du shes pa/ yang na bar byed 'du byed pa/ tsher ma'i zug gi rnam par shes par te/ lus la na tsha sems la sdug bsngal ci byung yang phung po lnga po 'di'i steng du ma gtogs pa gzhan du mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i cha shas nyer len zag bcas kyi phung po rnams dang mi ldan pa 'phags pa'i ye shes shig cis kyang thob par bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so lnga pa'o/ / de nas lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal ni/ lha'i dpal la mi bzod pas rtag tu phrag dog cing*/ g.yul 'gyed pas shin tu gdung ba dang*/ rang rang gi gnas ris gcod cing 'tshe bas lus sems 'khrugs pa'i zug rngu chen po kha smras dang 'thab rtsod rdo ba lta bus rgyun du gdung ba'i phyir/ da res zhi ba dam pa'i chos sgrub dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so drug pa'o/ / de nas lha'i sdug bsngal ni/ 'dod lha'i gnas na dar cig bde yang 'chi 'pho ba'i tshe sngon gyi las dge ba zad/ mi dge ba'i 'bras bu ngan 'gror skye ba mngon shes kyis shes pas/ nya bye tshan la bsgres pa bas che ba'i sdug bsngal drag po lha'i zhag bdun myong dgos pa dang*/ gzugs dang gzugs med na ting nge 'dzin gyi bde ba la dar cig spyod kyang*/ yang las bzang po zad/ ngan pa'i stobs kyis srid pa 'og mar ltung ba'i sdug bsngal 'du byed pas/ phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba 'gyur ba dang*/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la spyod pa'i phyir/ da res khams gsum rigs drug nas cis kyang thar ba zhig bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so bdun pa'o/ / de nas da lta'i tshul la dpag pa ni/ 'di ltar da res rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob cing rang dbang rang la yod dus 'dir/

lus la me skar phog pa tsam gyi sdug bsngal yang mi bzod/ cung zad grang ba bkres skom ngal dub kyi sdug bsngal phra mo yang mi bzod na/ shi nas dmyal ba tsha grang*/ yi dgas bkres skom/ dud 'gro bkol spyod la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag la rgyun ring ba bzod par ji ltar nus/ da lta nyin re'i nad dang sdug bsngal yang mi bzod na/ 'khor ba mtha' med kyi sdug bsngal ji ltar bzod snyam du sbyor dgos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so brgyad pa'o/ / don bzhi pa la rgyu 'bras bsam pa la/ mi dge ba'i las/ dge ba'i las/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bsams pa gsum las/ dang po mi dge ba'i las bcu'i lus gsum ni/ srog bcad pas gang du skyes pa der tshe thung zhing nad mang la/ yul yang nyams mi dga' ba'i ngam grog dang g.yang sa la sogs pa tshe la bar du gcod par gnas pa dang*/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal myong ba la sogs pa'o/ /ma byin par blangs pas dbul zhing phongs la sad ser mu ges nyen pa'i yul ngan par gnas pa dang*/ ngan song gsum las khyad par yi dwags kyi yul du skye ba la sogs pa'o/ /log par g.yem pas khyim thab mi mdzes la dgra zla dang bcas shing*/ tsha sgo dang yongs su dri nga la btsog pa'i yul du gnas pa dang*/ ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong bar byed pa'i phyir/ bdag gis deng nas lus kyi mi dge ba gsum po spang dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang so dgu pa'o/ / de nas ngag gi bzhi ni/ rdzun gyis skur pa mang zhing rtag tu gzhan gyis bslu ba dang*/ phra mas 'khor 'dab mi mdza' zhing phan btags pa'ang dgrar ldang ba dang*/ tshig rtsub mos mi snyan pa 'ba' zhig rna bar thos shing 'thab mo'i tshig tu 'gyur ba dang*/ ngag 'khyal pas tshig mi btsun zhing 'chol ba ste/ ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i gnas su brgyud cing sdug bsngal myong bar nges pas/

bdag gis spang dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bzhi bcu pa'o/ / de nas yid kyi gsum ni brnab sems kyis gang bsam pa mi 'grub cing ma bsams pa thog tu 'bab pa dang*/ gnod sems kyis rtag tu 'jigs shing 'tshe dogs mang la nyams nga ba dang*/ log ltas lta ba ngan pa rgyu 'bras med pa dang rtag chad kyi lus ngan pa la gnas te/ ngan 'gror 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung ba'i phyir/ bdag gis spang bar bya'o snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe gcig pa'o/ / de nas dge ba'i las la/ bsod nams cha mthun dang*/ thar pa cha mthun gyi las gnyis las/ dang po la/ dge ba bcu'i lus kyi las gsum ni/ srog gcod pa spangs pas tshe ring zhing nad med pa dang*/ ma byin par len pa spangs pas longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ 'dod log spangs pas mthun pa'i khyim thab mdzes zhing dgra zla med pa ste/ bde 'gro yid du 'ong ba'i bde ba thob pa'i phyir/ bdag gis rgyud la brten dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang pas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe gnyis pa'o/ / de nas ngag gi bzhi ni/ rdzun spangs pas kun gyis bstod cing dga' bar byed pa dang*/ phra ma spangs pas 'khor g.yog mthun zhing mchog tu gus pa dang*/ tshig rtsub spangs pas rna bar snyan cing bstod pa dang*/ ngag 'khyal spangs pas tshig bzung bar 'os shing tshad mar byed pa ste/ ngag gi dge ba dang bde ba thams cad 'grub pas/ bdag gis brten par bya'o snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe gsum pa'o/ / de nas yid kyi las gsum ni/ brnab sems spangs pas re ba 'grub pa dang*/ gnod sems spangs pas 'tshe ba med pa dang*/ log lta spangs pas lta ba bzang por 'gyur zhing*/ yid kyi dge ba dang legs pas mtho ris kyi dga' bde 'grub ba'i phyir/

bdag gis nyams su blang bar bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe bzhi pa'o/ / de nas thar pa cha mthun gyi las ni/ dge ba gang byed kyang 'khor ba las thar nas zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya snyam ste/ bsdu na/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thar pa gsum la ltos nas gsum du yod kyang*/ da res rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'dod pas dge ba bcu dang*/ bsam gtan bzhi dang*/ gzugs med bzhi dang*/ zhi lhag gnyis dang*/ tshad med bzhi dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa thams cad la/ sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos po bden zhen gyi dmigs pa med pa/ rjes bsngo ba gsum gyis zin par byas la skad cig kyang ma dal bar sgrub dgos/ tshogs ma rdzogs na sangs rgyas mi thob pa'i phyir snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe lnga pa'o/ / de nas thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba'i bde sdug dang mtho dman thams cad kyang rang rang gi las dge sdig gis byas pa yin la/ byang chub gsum dang de'i bde legs tha dad pa'ang thar pa cha mthun gyi las khyad par can so sos byas pa'i phyir/ las 'di ni ri mo mkhan dang 'dra ba/ gcig gis mang po'i rnam par bsgyur ba/ rjes su 'gro bas lus kyi grib ma dang 'dra ba/ rang gis byas pa gzhan la mi 'pho/ gzhan gyi las rang la mi 'pho bas lus tha dad kyi bde sdug lta bu/ dge sdig gi shugs drags pas mtho ris dang ngan 'gror 'phen pa rgyal po dbang po che lta bu/ rgya ni rgya che bas nam mkha'i dbyings lta bu/ rnam pa grangs mang bas tshong dus kyi zong lta bu/ phan tshun gcig tu mi 'dre ba'i za 'og gi ber khyim lta bu/ dkar nag ngo bo mi 'gyur bas ut+pal dang ku mu ta lta bu ste/ gang ci bsags pa de dang mthun pa'i 'bras bu re 'byin par byed pa'i phyir bdag gis thams cad las su shes par byas la blang dor brtson par bya dgos snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams blang ngo*/

/ khrid rkang zhe drug pa'o/ / don lnga pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten par gdamasapa las/ rang bzhin bsam pa dang rnal 'byor bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po la'ang khyad par bsam pa/ mtshan nyid brtag pa/ yon tan bsngags pa dang gsum las/ dam pa dang dam pa ma yin pa'i khyad par blang dor du bya ba ni/ yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten na de'i yon tan dge ba dang legs pa ngang gis 'go ba ni tsan+dan gyi shing drung du 'khod nas spos dri zhib po'i ngad 'go blta bu'o/ /de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang dge ba'i grogs po bsten par bya ste/ bdag gi dge ba gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngan pa dang sdig pa'i grogs la brten na de'i skyon ngang gis 'go ba ni mi gtsang ba'i khrod du ku sha nya rul gyis bsgos pa lta bu'o/ /de'i phyir bdag gis sdig pa'i bshes gnyen sdig grogs dang bcas pa spang dgos te/ mi dge ba'i phyogs dag bsrabs shing spangs nas med par bya dgos pa'i phyir ro snyam du sbyor dngos rjais gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe bdun pa'o/ / de nas mtshan nyid brtag pa la gnyis las/ thun mong gi mtshan nyid ni/ nor bu'i gling du 'khrid pa ded dpon mkhas pa'i rang bzhin can la rag las pa ltar bdag gis thar pa'i gling du phyin nas sangs rgyas thob pa'ang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa skyon med cing yon tan phun sum tshogs pas brgyan pa/ thos pa dang snying rje che ba/ tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnga' ba/ 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam la 'god pa/ skyo dub dang dka' spyad bzod pa zhig la brten par bya/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang myur du 'phrad cing thugs rjes 'dzin par shog cig /rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/

/ khrid rkang zhes brgyad pa'o/ / de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ tshe 'dir dngos mnga' ris dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs pa sbyin pa 'khor los sgyur ba la sogs pa rgyal po bzang po la rag las pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang tshe gcig gi bla na med pa'i 'bras bu dang yon tan thob pa bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhas grub dam pa la rag las pas/ bla ma dam pa dbang dang dam tshig phun sum tshogs pa/ rgyud dang man ngag gi gnas la mkhas pa/ bsnyen sgru zab mo'i nus pa thob pa/ lta dgongs ting nge 'dzin gyi gding tshad mnga' ba/ gzhan don phrin las phun sum tshogs pa zhig la brten par bya dgos/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang ma mjal ba mjal bar shog cig /mjal zin rnams dang mi 'bral bar shog cig /rtag tu mnyes shing thugs rjes 'dzin par shog cig snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang zhe dgu pa'o/ / de nas yon tan bsngags pa la rim pa gsum las/ rim pa dang po ni/ 'jig rten na u dum wā ra'i me tog 'byung ba dka' ba ltar sangs rgyas 'byung dka'/ de'i thugs rje las sprul pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa'ang 'byung dka' ste/ da res bdag cag gi dpal mgon bla ma dam pa 'dis mtshon nas yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la yon tan tshad med pa'i 'od zer mnga' bas ni/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru chen mnyen pa lta bu/ thar pa'i lam sna 'dren pas ded dpon mkhas pa lta bu/ srid zhi'i rgud pa sel bas yid bzhin nor bu lta bu/ nyon mongs me dpung 'jil bas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyud lta bu/ chos kyi char chen 'bebs pas char sprin bzang po lta bu/ 'gro kun dga' ba bskyed pas lha'i rnga sgra lta bu/ dug gsum nad kun sel bas sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu/ ma rig mun pa sel bas nyi zla sgron me lta bu/ 'dod gu'i re ba 'byung bas dpag bsam shing chen lta bu/

phrin las 'od stong mnga' bas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i yon tan mnga' ba ste ngo mtshar to/ /deng sang bdag lta bus mjal zhing rten du yod pa la spro dga' mchog tu skye nas/ tshe rabs nas tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten zhing thugs rjes 'dzin par gyur cig bdag kyang nam zhig na de kho na 'dra bar thob par shog cig snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang lnga bcu pa'o/ / de nas rim pa gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ltar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa rnams kyis dgongs pa nam mkha' ltar rgya che/ ting 'dzin nyi zla ltar 'od gsal/ mkhyen rab rgya mtsho ltar tshad med/ thugs rje chu klung ltar shugs drag /rang bzhin ri rgyal ltar thugs brtan/ skyon bral pad+ma ltar rnam dag 'gro la pha ma ltar thugs snyoms/ yon tan gter mdzod ltar lhun grub/ 'jig rten rgyal ba ltar yongs su 'dren pa'i rang bzhin dam pa ste/ yon tan re re'i cha yang dpag gis mi langs pas ngo mtshar/ rtag tu dgyes shing thugs rjes 'dzin par shog cig snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nga gcig pa'o/ / de nas rim pa gsum pa ni/ 'dir ltar dpal mgon bla ma dam pa rnams ni mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa dang reg pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs shing 'khor ba phyir bsnyil bas sangs rgyas kun dang phrin las kyi byed pa gcig pa dang*/ thar pa'i lam du 'dren pas skal ba mchog tu gyur pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gang du he ru ka'i ngo bor dbang rdzogs thams cad kyi bya ba byed pas dkon mchog bzhi par byon pa dang*/ gdul ngor sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin mchog tu che ba'i yon tan mnga' ba ste/ tshe 'dir smin grol zab mo'i lam la 'god pa'i ngang can rnams la tshe rabs thams cad du bsten cing mnyes nas thugs rjes byin gyis rlobs par shog cig snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/

khrid rkang nga gnyis pa'o/ / de nas rnal 'byor bsgom pa la gsum las/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed nas/ stong pa'i ngang las/ nyin mo spyi gtsug mtshan mo snying nang du pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ yi dam mkha' 'gro dang bcas pas skor bar bsams la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa spyan drangs la thim pa la/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ sdig pa bshags pa/ gsol ba gdam pa rnams bya ste/ na mo bla ma yid dam dang*/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul/ /rtsa ba yan lag nyams chag bshags/ / smin grol dbang dang byin rlabs stsol/ /tshe rabs 'dren ston mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ sku'i cha shas nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ lus kyi nang khengs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dag /bde chen chos nyid kyi rtogs pa skyes par bsams la dar cig mnyam par bzhag nas/ bla ma gang yin gyi mtshan de shes pa rgya skad du bsgyur la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi sgrom nas bzlas so/ /oṃ gu ru ku mā rā tsa sid+dhi āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /de nas bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro'i sku las 'od dang bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ gsung las ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka nas 'od dang bdud rtsis yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ thams cad las 'od dang bdud rtsis lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshig dbang rin po che thob/ ye shes rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la thim/ de nyid chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang la thim pas/ gang yang yid la mi byed pa'i ngang la bzhag nas bsngo ba bya'o/

/ khrid rkang nga gsum pa'o/ / de nas las tshogs kyi rim pa ni/ zhi ba la de thams cad dkar por bsam pa'i 'od zer dkar pos nad gdong sdig sgrib zhi bar bsams la/ sngags kyi sham bur shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ rgyas pa la thams cad ser por bsams pa'i 'od zer gyis tshe dang bsod nams dang 'byor pa rgyas par bsams la/ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ dbang la thams cad dmar por 'phro bas bsgrub bya dbang du byas par bsams la/ che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ drag po la thams cad mthing nag me'i 'od zer dang tsha tsha 'phro bas gdon bgegs tshar bcad par bsams la/ gdon bgegs mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ dmigs pa gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra'o/ / khrid rkang nga bzhi pa'o/ / de nas nad gdon 'chi bslu'i tshe/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong seng ge rin po che'i khri rkang gis bteg pa'i steng du nyi zla dar 'bol brtsegs pa'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dang dbyer med du bsams pa'i mthar/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsha'i tshogs dang*/ 'og tu rigs drug gnod byed dang bcas pa bsams la/ de nas rang gi snying nang nas rnam shes hūṃ gi rnam pa tshangs bug nas thon pas dpa' bo rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro chu gri thogs par gyur pa des/ rang gi thod pa smin mtshams kyi mdzod pur bcad nas/ thod pa'i sgyed po ri rab tsam pa gsum gyi steng du bzhag pa'i nang du lus kyi sha khrag blugs te/ 'og nas me 'bar bas khol ba la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bdud rtsi byung bas khengs te/ ci 'dod pa'i bza' btung dang bdud rtsi bzang por gyur pa de/ dpa' bo thod pa thogs pa grangs med pa lag bde'i tshul du sprul pas mgron rnams so so spyan sngar dus mnyam du drangs pas/

'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron rnams mnyes te tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ 'khor ba'i mgron rnams mnyes te thog ma med pa'i lan chags khyer zhing bu lon sbyangs/ khyad par du gnod byed kyi bgegs rigs mnyes pas gdug sems dang bar chad zhi/ thams cad mnyes pa'i 'od zer rang la phog pas nad zhi gdon zhi 'chi ba bslus shing dngos grub thob par bsams nas/ de thams cad nam mkha' la sprin dngas pa ltar ci yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bsngo ba bya'o/ / 'dis ni tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ 'chi ba slus pa dang*/ gnad gcod med pa dang*/ bar do'i 'od gsal zin par byed pa'o/ / khrid rkang nga lnga pa'o/ / don drug pa skyabs su 'gro ba la/ khyad par dbye ba/ phan yon bsam pa/ skyabs su 'gro tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'di ltar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal la 'jig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi bde ba don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro na skyes bu chung ngu zhes bya ste/ 'bras bu gnas skabs kyi bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba las gzhan med pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skrag nas rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde don du gnyer ba'i phyir dkon mchog gsum la skya su 'gro na skyes bu 'bring po zhes bya ste/ 'khor ba las rang nyid tsam thar pa'i 'bras bu la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /mtha' med par 'khor ba'i sems can gzhan rnams kyis sdug bsngal mthong nas/ de rnams 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i phyir dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro na skyes bu chen po zhes bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa la dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ / de'i phyir bdag gis skyes bu chung ngu dang*/ 'bring gi cha las log ste sems can thams cad kyi don du skyes bu chen po'i rjes su bslab par bya'o snyam pa sbyor dngos rjais gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/

/ khrid rkang nga drug pa'o/ / de nas phan yon bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar rang nyid 'khor ba na 'khor ba/ 'jig rten pa'i lha la yang skyabs su 'gro na/ 'jig med thar pa'i mchog la gnas pa dkon mchog gsum la c-i'i phyir skyabs su mi 'gro /brtan par dka' zhing gnod pa sbyin pa'i rang bzhin rgyal po la sogs pa yang mgon dang skya su mi 'gro/ gang gi skyabs su song ba tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'debs pa dang*/ mi dge'i tshogs las ring du byed cing dge ba gong du 'phel ba dang*/ sdom pa kun gyi rten du rung zhing yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa dang*/ 'dir yang dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis bsrung zhing smon pa'i re ba yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ rtag du tshe rabs dran cing dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba dang mi 'bral ba dang*/ 'di phyir bde zhing mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa la sogs pa dpag tu med pa la bsams te sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang nga bdun pa'o/ / de nas skyabs su 'gro tshul ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du gdan seng ge dang pad+ma nyi zla rin po che'i steng du bla ma dang sangs rgyas dbyer med du bzhugs pa la/byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor bas nam mkha' khyab par bsams la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad sa gzhi'i ngos nas thal mo sbyar te/ dus 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar du khyed la 'bul/ khyed la brten/ khyed ma gtogs pa re ba'i gnas dang skyabs gzhan med ces bsam zhing gdangs snyan pos/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ / sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mcho'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci 'grub tu brjod pa'i rjes su/ bdag dang sems can thams cad dkon mchog gsum la thim/ de yang dbus kyi bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la thim/

de yang chos sku spros bral stong pa'i ngang du thim pas/ gang la'ang dmigs su med pa'i ngang la glod nas ji tsam blo gnas kyi bar du bsgom/ de nas bsngo ba bya'o/ /'di ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi ma ste gal po che yin pas nan tan du bya'o/ / khrid rkang nga brgyad pa'o/ / don bdun pa tshad med bzhi'i bsgom tshul la gsum ste/ phan yon la bsams ste bsgom pa la spro dga' bskyed la/ bsgom tshul dngos/ rtsal sbyang pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di ltar tshad med bzhi ma bsgoms na sangs rgyas su mi 'grub cing*/ bsgoms na 'grub pas kyang bsgoms dgos la/ byam pas ni gnas skabs kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing mthar thugs longs sku 'grub pa dang*/ snying rjes 'tshe ba med cing chos sku 'grub pa dang*/ dga' bas phrag dog med cing sprul sku 'grub pa dang*/ btang snyoms kyis sems las su rung zhing ngo bo nyid kyi sku 'grub pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'dod par lha mi'i lus grub pas phan bde byed la/ gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin dang skyes gnas dag pa'i yon tan mngon du byed pa'i phyir/ bdag gis phan yon la bsams te sgrub pa bya'o snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khṛd rkang nga dgu pa'o/ / de nas bsgom tshul dngos la bzhi las/ dang po btang snyoms bsgom pa la'ang dmigs pa dang*/ rnam pa gnyis las/ dmigs yul yongs su brtags nas shes par bya ba ni/ da ltar pha ma dang gnyen 'dun la sogs pa rang gi phyogs la chags shing*/ dgra dang de'i phyogs la sdang ba'i sems 'di mi rig ste/ tshe rabs snga ma dgra 'dis kyang gnyen byas la/ gnyen gyis kyang*/ dgra byas pa'i phyir ma nges pa dang*/ da lta'ang rtag tu dgras kyang gnod par mi nus shing bstun na gnyen zhing phan pa'ang srid la/ gnyen gyis kyang tshig mi snyan par smra ba dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ nor rdzas 'god pa dang*/ de la mi 'dod pa byung na rang gi sems la zug rngu bskyed pa'i phyir dgra bzhin don la gnas pa dang*/

ma 'ongs pa na'ang gnyen dgrar 'gyur ba dang*/ dgra gnyen du 'gyur ba dang*/ nges pa med pa'i phyir/ rang phyogs la chags/ gzhan phyogs la sdang ba'i sems kyis nye ring spangs la dgra gnyen ngo mnyam gyi don la brtag cing*/ sems can thams cad la de ltar blta ba ni yul la dmigs pa'o/ /blo'i rnam pa ni de ltar sems can gcig nas gnyis dang gsum dang grong gcig dang*/ yul khams gcig dang gling gcig nas nam mkha' mtha'i bar la/ nye ring chags sdang dang dmigs pa med pa'i btang snyoms chen po sbyor dngos rjais gsum pas bsgom par bya'o/ / khrid rkang drug cu pa'o/ / de nas byams pa bsgoms pa'ang gnyis las/ dmigs yul ni sems can thams cad de/ rang phyogs la bde ba dang mi ldan pa kun bde ba dang 'phrad par smon pa bzhin/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang mi ldan pa ji snyed do/ /kun bde ba dang phrad par gyur cig snyam du byams pas bdag gir bya ba'i yul du mthong nas/ blo'i rnam pa ni rang gi pha ma lta bus mtshon nas snying nye ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa dang*/ de nas gcig nas kun gyi bar de ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ gang du'ang dmigs pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag pa ni sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ / de nas snying rje bsgom pa la'ang*/ dmigs yul sdug bsngal drag pos gdungs pa blos mi bzod pa zhig bsams la/ blo'i rnam pa sdug bsngal 'di dang bral bar shog cig snyam pa'i snying rje dung dung ba sems can gcig nas kun gyi bar la bsgoms pa'i rjes gang yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas dar cig mnyam par gzhag pa ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum du bya'o/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ / de nas dga' ba ni/ mtho ris kyi yul na su gang zhig bde zhing skyid pa che chung ci yod pa nas/ bde ba dang ldan pa'i cha thams cad dmigs yul du byas te/ blo'i rnam pa bde ba 'di dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing 'di bas kyang skyid cing bde ba tshe ring ba/

'khor mang ba/ longs spyaud 'byor pa/ 'tshe ba med pa/ shes rab che ba la sogs pas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'byor par shog cig snyam du sems can gcig nas kun gyi bar la sbyang zhing*/ khyad par du rang la gnod pa'i dgra dang sems la phrag dog gi gnas su gyur pa rnams la yang dang yang du sbyang ba'i mthar stong nyid kyi ngang la bzhag pa ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa gsum pa'o/ / de nas rtsal sbyang ba ni/ go rims nges pa can/ byams pa/ snying rje/ dga' ba/ btang snyoms bzhi po rim pas bsgom zhing*/ yang bzlog nas bsgom pa btang snyoms nas byams pa'i bar dang*/ spel ma byams pa dga' ba/ snying rje dang btang snyoms bsgom zhing*/ skad cig skad cig la goms par sbyong ba'o/ /de dag sbyor ba sems bskyed dngos gzhi de nyid la brtson bzhin du zhen pa med pa/ rjes bsngo ba gsum gyis zin par nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ / don brgyad pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa bslab bya dang bcas pa la phan yon bsam pa/ bskyed tshul dngos bslab bya bsam pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos rnams kyi nang nas byang chub sems bskyed pa kho na mchog tu 'phags pa yin la/ sems ma bskyed na sangs rgyas su mi 'grub la/ bskyed na 'grub pa'i phyir dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las skyob pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba sel ba dang*/ nyan rang gi theg pa las 'phags pa dang*/ dge rtsa mi zad cing 'phel ba dang*/ bsod nams rgya chen po thob pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung 'tshob pa dang*/ bde skyid kyi gzhi thengs pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi mchod sdong du 'gyur ba dang*/ ci bsam thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub pa dang*/ myur du byang chub thob pa la sogs pa ste/ bdag gis de ring nyid du sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du sbyor dngos rdzes gsum tshang bas 'bad do/

/ khrid rkang drug cu rtsa lnga pa'o/ / de nas sems bskyed tshul dngos la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba la bdun gyis phyaga'atshal ba'i yan lag ni/ dkon mchog rten gyi drung du mchod pa bshams/ steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkon mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong ba'i srung ma sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam bsams la/ rang gi lus brgya stong bye ba grangs med pa gzhi khyab pa tsam dang*/ khams gsum rigs drug gi sems can thams cad kyang phyag 'tshal bar dmigs te/ bstod dbyangs dang bcas pas rtogs pa brjod pa'i mdo sde dbang po'i rgyal po dang*/ byang chub ltung bshags dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan mang dang*/ sangs rgyas stong rtsa dang*/ zhi khro skong gi phyag la sogs pa/ lus bsrang*/ thal mo snying ga mgrin pa sbyi bo gsum gang rung du sbyor la/ pus mo sa la phab ste yan lag smad lnga btud pa'i phyag brgya stong mang po sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas btsal lo/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa drug pa'o/ / de nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni/ dkon mchog gi drung du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang khyad par mar me'i phreng ba dang bdug spos kyi dri bshams la/ nam mkha' dang sa gzhi thams cad lha dang mi'i mchod rdzas spos me tog mar me la sogs pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang dang dag pa la sogs pa yul 'khor kun nas dga' ba sna tshogs dang*/ rgyal sridabadun dang bkra shis brgyad la sogs pa dang*/ lha dang lha mo'i khyad par mang po glu gar dang rol mo'i sprin phung 'phro bas zhing khams 'di dang gzhan gyi dkon mchog thams cad mchod par bsams la/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod 'jug la sogs pa nas byung ba'i mchod 'bul rnams dang*/ 'di'i skabs nas bshad pa'i/ dngos su 'byor dang la sogs pas mchod nas/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod rdzas thams cad dmigs pa med par shes pas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas mchod do/

khrid rkang drug cu rtsa bdun pa'o/ / de nas sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ rten gyi drung du thal mo sbyar te gnong zhing 'gyod pas/ dran pa dang mi dran pa'i sdig pa tshe thog ma med pa nas/ de ring yan chad bsags pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas/ pha ma dang mkhan po slob dpon dang mched grogs dang*/ skye bo gzhan dag la ma gus pa byas pa/ sdig pa mi dge ba bcu/ mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba lnga/ dkon mchog gi dkor la 'bags pa/ ser sna dang 'jur gegs byas pa la sogs pa thams cad lce thog tu nag phungs kyis 'dus par bsams nas bshags pas/ skad cig de la rten gyi sku gsung thugs las 'od byung bas phog nas sangs kyis dag par bsams la/ phyis mi byed par gnyen pos bsdam zhing*/ sdig pa bshags pa'i tshig byang chub ltung bshags la sogs pa mdo rgyud nas byung ba kun brjod pa'i mthar/ gang la bshags pa'i rten/ gang bshags pa'i sdig pa/ gang gis bshags pa'i sdig pa rnams mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhags pa ste sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ / de nas rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ sbyor ba sems bskyed nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyis gzhan don du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa'i dge ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis byang chub kyi spyod pa rlabs po che spyad pa'i dge ba/ sems can gang gis bsod nams dang thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba bskrun pa/ rang gis kyang sngar byas pa/ da lta byed bzhin pa/ slad kyis byed par nges pa thams cad la rjes su yi rangs dung dung pa snying thag pa nas/ gcig nas kun gyis dge ba thams cad la bsgoms pa'i mthar/ gang la'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag nas bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang drug cu rtsa dgu pa'o/ / de nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i yan lag ni/ rten gyi drung du 'dug ste sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po gzhan don rlabs po che la gshegs pa rnams las/

chos mi gsung bar bzhugs pa dag gi drung du/ sngon tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis zhu ba phul pa ltar/ bdag kyang lus bye ba mang por sprul te 'khor lo dang nor bu la sogs pa phul nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar zhus pas thams cad kyis gnang nas chos kyi char phab par bsam zhing*/ bzang po spyod pa la sogs pa nas gsungs pa ltar brjod nas gang du'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang las rjes bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu pa'o/ / de nas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar sems can gyi don du gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag ni/ sems bskyed nas zhing khams 'di dang gzhan dag na bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sems can gyi don mdzad zin nas mya ngan las 'da' bar dgongs pa dag gi mdun du/ sngon dge bsnyen tsun+das gsol ba btab pa ltar/ bdag gi lus mang por sprul pa dag gis gsol ba gtab pas/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du bzhugs nas don mdzad par bsams la mdo dang bstan bcos dag nas 'byung ba ltar brjod pa'i rjes la gang du'ang mi dmigs pa'i bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu don gcig pa'o/ / de nas bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/ phyag 'tshal ba nas bzung ste/ da ltar byas pa'i dge ba 'dis mtshon nas/ /rang gzhan dus gsum dang 'brel par bsags pa'i dge ba thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi bar bsngo ba ste/ de'i tshig kyang 'phags pa rnams kyis mdo rgyud dang bstan bcos chen por gsungs pa bzhin brjod nas/ dar cig rang bzhin med pa'i ngang du bzhag pa'i rjes la yang bsngo bar bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ / de nas dngos gzhi ni/ de nas rten gyi drung du thal mo sbyar te/ bdag gis sems can gyi don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab cing 'khor ba nas sems can gcig kyang mi gnas pa de tsam du brtson 'grus brtsam snyam pas tshig gi rgyal po 'di dag brjod par bya'o/

/bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba dus 'di nas sny-ing po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag byang chub sems dpar rjes su gzung du gsol/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams bdag la dgong su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub chen por sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /don dam sems bskyed ni mtshan nyid bsgoms stobs kyis thob pa las/ cho ga la mi ltos par mkhas pa rnams bzhed do/ / de ltar brjod pa gsum gyi mthar bdag nyid byang chub sems dpar gyur/ mi'i srid pa don dang bcas lha dang bcas pa'i mchod sdaung du gyur/ las kyi dbang gis ngan 'gror ltung ba'i sgo 'phar bcad/ bde ba nas bde bar mtho ris kyi 'jig rten rnams su 'gro/ gzhan don rlabs po che 'grub/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras su gyur/ byang chub myur du thob pa la bsams te gzengs bstod de spro dga' bskyed do/

/ khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa gsum pa'o/ / de nas bslab bya bsam pa la smon 'jug gnyis las/ dang po smon pa'i bslabs bya bsam pa la/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa/ brje ba/ gzhan gces par gzung ba byang chub bsgom pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag gzhan mnyam pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad dang bdag gnyis bde ba 'dod/ sdug bsngal mi 'dod/ rtag tu skyid cing legs na dga' bar chabs gcig kyang sems can gyis de'i rgyu dge sdig blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pas rtag tu sdug bsngal ba 'di snying re rje/ kye ma sems can bde ba dang mi ldan pa rnams bde ba dang 'phrad/ sdug bsngal gyis nyam thag pa rnams sdug bsngal dang bral/ bde zhing skyid pa rnams dga' bde de dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral/ nye ring chags sdang can rnams chags sdang med pa'i btang snyoms la gnas/ kun kyang thar pa'i lam la zhugs te rtag tu dge ba'i chos la spyod cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig snyam du snying thag pa nas 'dun pa drag pos bsgoms pa'i rjes la/ chos thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid la dar cig glod nas 'khor gsum rnams par dag pas bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ / de nas bdag gzhan brje ba byang chub kyi sems ni/ gang snying rje ba'i sems kyis gcig thog mar mdun du bsams nas/ rang gi bde ba dang legs pa lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa thams cad blos lings kyis phud de gos g.yogs pa ltar de la sbyin pas bde zhing skyid par 'gyur/ de'i sdug bsngal ci yod pa kun tshur blangs te rang gi steng du bzhag pas sdug cing bsngal ba la dga' ba bskyed de dang du blangs pa ni gos brje ba ltar bya zhing*/ 'byongs dus dbugs phar rgyu ba na bdag gi dge ba sems can la sbyin/

tshur rngub dus sems can gyi sdug bsngal dang du blangs pa la sbyang ngo*/ /dai ltar sems can gcig nas thams cad kyi bar du btang len spel mar bya zhing lhag pa'i brtson 'grus nyin mtshan du 'bad de sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa lnga pa'o/ / de nas gzhan gces par bzung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni/ bu gcig pa'i ma bu la brtse ba ltar bsgom ste/ sems bskyed nas gang skye bar sla ba'i sems can snying la ma gcig mdun du bsams nas de'i sdug bsngal blos mi bzod pa tsam du bdag gis dang du blang zhing bdag gi dge ba de la byin pas bde bar bsams la/ bdag 'khor bar gnas rung*/ na rung*/ shi rung/ nyams nyes ci byung yang bzod kyi/ 'di 'khor bar 'khyams sdug bsngal bar ga la bzod snyam du brtse sems thun mong ma yin pa bskyed do/ /de bzhin du sems can kun la bsgom zhing*/ sems can thams cad kyi gnyer ka nga la yod snyam nas/ bdag la phan rung*/ gnod rung*/ gang ci mthong ba dang thos pa'i sems can gyis mtshon nas nam mkha' mtha' khyab kyi sems can kun la lhag pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis blta zhing*/ thun rjes dmigs pa med pa'i ngang las bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa drug pa'o/ / de nas 'jug pa'i bslab bya pha rol tu phyin pa drug las/ dang po sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ ngas sems can gyi don du sbyin pa gtong snyam du sems bskyed nas/ sems can gyi yul la dngos su zang zing dang chos kyi sbyin pa ci 'grub dang*/ yid kyis lus longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pa sbyin te/ gtong ba dang yongs su gtong ba dang shin tu gtong ba gsum dngos dang yid kyis bya/ dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa ci 'grub dang*/ ting nge 'dzin yid kyis mchod pa 'bul/ 'byung po dang yi dwags la gtor ma dang chu sbyin gtong nas/ gang yang dmigs su med pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba

bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa bdun pa'o/ / de nas tshul khrims kyi pha rol la tu phyin pa la/ ngo bo dang khyad par la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyes spyod spangs pa'i sems dge bas rgyud bsdam pa yin te/ sems bskyed nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rab tu byung ba yin na/ sngar nyan thos kyi skabs su blangs pa'i sdom khrims la nan tan du byed cing bshags sdom dang gnyen po bsten pa'i steng du smon 'jug byang chub kyi sems bsrung zhing*/ yang dang yang du cho gas blangs pa dang*/ khyim pa yin na'ang byang chub kyi sdom pa la bslab pa dang*/ gnyis kas rang gi rgyud sdom pa dang*/ gzhan la phan gdags pa dang*/ cho gas yang yang blang zhing rjes la mi dmigs pa'i ngang las bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ / de nas khyad par la bslab pa la gnyis las/ phyogs dang po/ spyod yul dag pa phal po che la/ byang chub sems dpa' khang pa'i nang du 'jug pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyis thar pa'i grong khyer thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyed do/ /nyal ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku thob par gyur cig dang*/ rmi lam rmis pa na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur rtogs par gyur cig dang*/ ske rags 'ching ba na dge ba'i rtsa ba dang 'brel bar gyur cig dang*/ stan la 'dug pa na rdo rje'i gdan thob par gyur cig dang*/ me btang ba na nyon mongs pa'i bud shing bsreg par gyur cig dang*/ 'bar ba na ye shes kyi me 'bar bar gyur cig dang*/ g.yos zin pa na ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thob par gyur cig dang*/ kha zas za ba na bsam gtan gyi zas thob par gyur cig dang*/ phyir 'gro ba na 'khor ba'i grong las thar bar gyur cig dang*/ skas las 'bab pa na sems can gyi don la 'khor bar 'jug par gyur cig dang*/ sgo 'byed pa na thar pa'i grong gi sgo 'byed par gyur cig dang*/ sgo gcod pa na ngan song gi sgo gcod par gyur cig dang*/

lam du 'jug pa na 'phags pa'i lam du 'jug par gyur cig dang*/ gyen la 'gro ba na sems can thams cad mtho ris kyi bde ba la 'god par gyur cig dang*/ thur la 'bab pa na ngan song gsum rgyun gcod par gyur cig dang*/ sems can dang 'phrad pa na sangs rgyas mjal bar gyur cig dang*/ rkang pa 'jog pa na sems can thams cad kyi don la 'gro bar gyur cig dang*/ rkang pa 'degs pa na 'khor ba nas 'don par gyur cig dang*/ rgyan dang ldan pa mthong na mtshan dang dpe byad kyi rgyan thob par gyur cig dang*/ rgyan med pa mthong na sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan par gyur cig dang*/ snod gang ba mthong na yon tan gyis gang bar gyur cig dang*/ stong pa mthong na skyon gyis stong par gyur cig dang*/ sems can dga' ba mthong na chos la dga' bar gyur cig dang*/ mi dga' ba mthong na 'dus byas kyi dngos po la mi dga' bar gyur cig dang*/ sems can bde ba mthong na sangs rgyas kyi bde ba thob par gyur cig dang*/ sdug bsngal ba mthong na sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar gyur cig dang*/ nad pa mthong na nad las grol par gyur cig dang*/ drin du gzo ba mthong na sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la drin lan ldan par gyur cig dang*/ drin du mi gzo ba mthong na lta ba log pa la drin du mi gzo par gyur cig dang*/ rgol ba mthong na phas kyi rgol ba thams cad tshar gcod nus par gyur cig dang*/ bstod pa mthong na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bstod par gyur cig dang*/ chos kyi gtam byed pa mthong na sangs rgyas kyi spobs pa thob par gyur cig dang*/ sku gzugs mthong na sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba la sgrib pa med par gyur cig dang*/ mchod rten mthong na 'gro ba thams cad kyi mchod rten du gyur par mthong bar gyur cig dang*/ tshong byed pa mthong na 'phags pa'i nor bdun thob par gyur

cig dang*/ phyag 'tshal bar mthong na lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi spyi gtsug bltar mi mngon pa thob par gyur cig snyam du sems bskyaid do zhes pa'i don sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang bdun cu rtsa dgu pa'o/ / de nas phyogs gnyis pa skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad bsgom pa ni/ sems bskyed nas bdag gis nam zhig sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sel nus/ nam zhig dbul bas nyen pa'i sems can rnams 'byor pa chen po la 'jog nus/ nam zhig sha khrag dang bcas pa'i lus kyis sems can gyi don nus/ nam zhig dmyal bar yun ring du gnas kyang sems can la phan 'dogs nus/ nam zhig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'byor pa chen pos sems can gyi re ba rdzogs par byed nus/ nam zhig sangs rgyas su gyur nas sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad nges par 'byin nus/ nam zhig sems can la mi phan pa'i skye ba dang*/ don dam pa'i ro la gcig tu spyod pa dang*/ skye bo thams cad la sim par mi byed pa'i tshig dang*/ gzhan la mi phan pa'i 'tsho ba dang*/ lus dang shes rab dang nor dang dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa byed pa la dga' bar tshe rabs thams cad du ma gyur cig snyam pa dang*/ nam zhig sems can gyi sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag la smin cing*/ bdag gi dge ba'i 'bras bu sems can la smin pas bde bar gyur cig snyam du bsam zhing rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ /

khrid rkang brgyad cu pa'o/ / de nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis las/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni/ 'di ltar dam pa'i chos bsgrub pa na/ dka' spyad kyi sdug bsngal la bzod pa/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dang len du bzod pa/ chos chen po'i gnas la mi skrag par bzod pa/ rang gi sems la bsran bzod pa rnams yin yang*/ skabs 'dir gtso bo gzhan gyi gnod pa la rang gi khro ba mi mched par bzod pa bsgom ste/ sems can thams cad du bzod pa bsgom snyam du sems bskyed nas/ 'khor gyis log bsgrubs sam don yod dam med pa'i 'tshe ba ci byung yang gze re'i sems btang nas rig pas 'di ltar brtag ste/ sems can rang bzhin gnod pa can yin pas kyang de 'byung la/ gnod lan gzhal gyis longs pa med pas bsran gzugs shing*/ bdag gis kyang sngon dus de ltar byas pa'i las ngan yin la/ bsran bzod na bsod nams kyi dam pa thob pas kyang bzod par rigs shing*/ rang gi las ma gtogs pa de'i gnod pas mtho dman mi nus pas kyang bzod par 'os la/ bcos su 'dug na de'i thabs la 'bad/ mi 'dug na mi bzod pa'i sems kyi gze res rang sdug pa las khebs med la/ slar gzhan gyi gnod pa je 'phel du 'gro bas kyang zug rngu'i sems kun nas khro ba spangs te/ lhod kyis zhi ba'i ngang la glod nas rjes la 'khor gsum dag pas bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ / de nas dmigs pa med pa'i bzod pa ni/ gnod byed dang bdag gi lus la rdul phran du gzhig pas cha med stong pa/ ngag la kha dog dang ngos gzung gzhig pas rang yal rjes med/ sems la ngo bo ngos gzung bltas pas dngos med du 'dug ste/ gnod byed dgra /gnod pa gtam mi snyan pa dang 'tshe ba dang yid mi bde ba la sogs pa/ gnod yul bdag rnams stong pa ris med du dag pas/ skye ba med pa'i ngang la glod nas bzhag go /de'ang sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas nyams su blang ngo/

/ khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ / de nas brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sems bskyed nas/ 'di ltar le los ni rang gi don yang mi 'grub na/ gzhan gyi don lta ci smos/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don bsgrub dgos pas brtson par bya'o snyam nas/ chos spyod bcu dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ phyag dang bskor ba la sogs pa ci 'grub dang*/ khyad par du yan lag bdun pa dang phung po gsum pa'i lag len la 'bad nas/ rjes la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i ngang las bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa'o/ / de nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la drug las/ dang po 'gyur zhing mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin la bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar skyes pa thams cad ni 'chi/ 'dus pa thams cad ni 'bral/ bsags pa thams cad ni 'dzad de/ 'byor pa thams cad ni rgud pa'i mtha' can te/ g.yo zhing snying po med pa tshe 'di'i snang ba mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin la chags pa rnams re phung*/ bdag kyang myur du 'chi/ nges par 'chi/ sang nang par ram/ do nub kyang mi 'chi ba'i dbang po med na/ 'khrul snang tshe 'di'i snang bas ci bya/ 'chi ba'i dus su phan par nges pa zab mo'i gdams ngag yin pas bsam gtan bsgom pa la 'bad dgos/ nyin mo/ mtshan mo/ skad cig /yud tsam/ thang cig 'gyur bas kyang 'chi ba la nyer song snyam du sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi pa'o/ / de nas 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ni/ 'di ltar 'dod pa rnams ni nyes pa mang ba ste/ bsags pa bsrung ba spel ba gsum gyis brel zhing mi dge ba 'phel ba/ kun dang rtsod pa dang bcas pa/ yod cing chog mi shes/ khengs shing ser sna 'phel ba zad kyis dogs/ blangs kyis dogs/ 'phrog gis dogs/ rkun po la sogs pa thams cad dang thun mong ba/ bsags kyang 'chi ba'i dus su thams cad 'jog cing 'bral ba'i rang bzhin can/

ji tsam du 'byor pa de tsam du sdug bsngal ba de bas mang ba ste/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa dang*/ tshul khrims la sogs pa rnam par gro ba'i chos dang 'gal ba/ 'phags pa rnams kyis kun du smad pa'o snyam du bsams nas/ rjes la skye ba med pa'i ngang du gzhag go /de yang sbyor dngos rjes gsum nges pas nyams su blang ngo*/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa'o/ / de nas byis dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa bsam pa ni/ sems bskyed nas/ 'di ltar khyim pa dang rab tu byung ba la sogs par snang ba so so skye bo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang*/ mdza' bshes dang*/ gnyen bdun dang*/ grogs dang*/ dgra dang*/ bar ma'i phyogs thams cad kyang 'grogs par mi bzod de/ rang bzhin ngan pa/ byas pa mi gzo ba/ phan pa'i lan du gnod pa sbyin pa/ 'dod pa che ba/ chog mi shes pa/ khong khro ba/ tshig rtsub pa/ rang gi 'dod pa 'ba' zhig sgrub pa/ gzhan la ngang gis gnod pa/ phyi thag thung ba/ rang gi 'byor pa dang legs pa nyams na 'dor zhing thing slad byed pa/ ngo tsha ba/ chos dang dam tshig la sogasas pa dang*/ la yogs dang rnam smin gang la'ang mi 'dzem pa/ don dang bya ba mang ba/ mgu bar shin tu dka' ba/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ phrag dog pa la sogs pa chos ma yin pa 'ba' zhig gis bslu zhing tshe 'da' ba'i rang bzhin te/ 'grogs pa tsam gyis dge ba 'grib cing mi dge ba 'phel ba'i byis pa rnams ni/ 'phags pa rnams kyis kyang ring du spang ba'i phyir/ bdag kyang thar pa'i dam pa bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pas su dang yang 'grogs par mi bya/ gcig pu zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgrub snyam du bsam zhing rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa drug pa'o/ / de nas 'du 'dzi'i nyes pa bsam pa ni/ /sems bskyed nas/ /'di ltar spyir 'jig rten gyi snang ba/ sgos tshe 'di'i bya ba rnams la zin pa dang chog pa'i dus med pa/ rtag tu brel zhing g.yengs la don chung ba/

ji tsam brtson kyang snying po med pa/ dgra btul yang mtha' med pa/ gnyen bskyangs kyang mtha' med pa/ tshongs so nam bzo rigs shes gnyen ci byas kyang lto gos kyi rtsol sgrub las/ byas pa don du 'gyur ba chos kyi lam du 'gro ba rdul tsam yang med pa/ nyin mo mtshan mo 'khor yug tu rnam g.yeng gi 'du 'dzis dus 'da' ba 'dis ci byed/ da res tshe 'di blos btang nas bsam gtan bsgom snyam du bsams pa'i rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa'o/ / de nas dben pa'i yon tan sems pa ni/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang zhi ba'i nags su bsgrubs pa las bdud rtsi brnyes pa'i phyir/ bdag kyang dben pa'i nags su 'gro bar spro ste/ de na 'du 'dzi dang rnam g.yengs med/ bya ba dang brel do med/ tshong dang so nam med/ byis pa dang 'grogs pa med/ bya dang ri dwags 'grogs na bde bas gang*/ chu dang lo ma la sogs pa dka' thub kyi zas dang mthun/ phug dang brag ri'i drung la sogs pa gnas mal chos dang mthun/ su yang bshes 'dres med pas dge ba ngang gis 'phel/ rig pa ngang gis dngas pas shes rab gsal la dngas/ des na dben pa'i yon tan mang bas de ring nyid nas dben par gnas dgos snyam du bsam zhing rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad pa'o/ / de nas bsam gtan bsgom pa dngos ni/ rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed de/ gang du'ang mi rtog ci yang mi 'dzin pa'i ngang la ma yengs par lhan ne bzhag pas/ snang yul ma 'gags la 'dzin rtog zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin skye'o/ /rjes la bsngo ba bya'au/ / khrid rkang brgyad cu rtsa dgu pa'o/ / de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gsum las/ dang po snang ba'i rang bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du blta ba ni/ sems bskyed nas/ 'di ltar phyi yul lngar snang ba thams cad ni med bzhin 'khrul pa'i ngo la snang bas/

rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu/ rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las glo bur bar snang bas sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bu/ med la yod par snang bas mig yor gyi snang ba lta bu/ snang dus bden par med pas smig rgyu'i rnam pa lta bu/ phyi nang gang la snang bas brag ca'i sgra brnyan lta bu/ rten dang brten par med pas dri za'i grong khyer lta bu/ snang la rang bzhin med pas gzugs brnyan gyi snang ba lta bu/ med snang cir yang shar bas sprul pa'i grong khyer lta bu/ ji ltar snang bzhin pa'i dus nas brdzun la dngos po med pa'i stong gzugs su 'dug snyam du bsgoms pa'i mthar bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang dgu bcu pa'o/ / de nas chos nyid stong pa la brtag pa ni sems bskyed nas/ phyi yul snang rags pa dang*/ rang gi lus kyi dngos po 'di rdul phran du gzhigs pas yul med stong par thag chod/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems la skad cig cha med du brtags pas 'dzin med stong par thag chod/ gzung 'dzin gang du'ang ma grub par rtog pa'i ngang der stong pa gtad med du mnyam par bzhag nas rjes la bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang dgu cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ / de nas mtha' bral dbu ma'i don la bzhag pa ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ lus mi g.yo/ ngag mi brjod/ sems mi rtog pas/ phyi yul snang ma 'gags la/ yul 'dzin gyi rnam rtog zhi/ nang rig pa stong gsal dngas la 'dzin zhen gyi spros pa zhi/ bar lus sems rten med la rang ngam gyis chos nyid shar te/ stong gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i rig pa/ smra bsam brjod med chen po'i ye shes/ blo bral dbu ma'i de kho na nyid kyi ngang la ji tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par gzhag /rjes snang rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang la bsngo ba bya'o/ / khrid rkang dgu cu rtsa gnyis pa'o/ / 'di ni mtshan nyid rgyu yi theg pa ste/ /dus gsum rgyal ba snga phyi'i gshegs shul yin/ /rang bzhin don gnyis bsgrub pa'i don chen te/

/ gnas skabs mthar thug don gnyis phun tshogs yin/ /mdo dang bstan bcos kun gyi snying po'i don/ /ji ltar nyams len phyogs gcig bkod pa des/ /ma lus 'gro kun thar pa'i lam zhugs te/ /sku dang ye shes phrin las lhun grub shog /rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i don khrid byang chub lam bzang las/ thog mar dge ba rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i gnas bstan pa ste dang po'o// // spyi don gnyis pa nang khyad par gyi lam 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa bar du dge ba'i khrid kyi rim pa rgya cher bstan pa la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams khrid gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sde'i gnas mang du thos shing de dag gi man ngag thams cad 'dus pa'i snying po yin pas brgyud rim du ma dgod pa yod mod kyang*/ 'dir gtso bo'i dbang du byas te gsang sngags rnying ma nges pa don gyi snying po sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i bla ma brgyud rim bstan pa ni/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pas brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung du brgyud pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos sku kun tu bzang po/ longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas/ sprul sku rigs gsum mgon pos gnas rigs so sor mi ma yin gyi rigs 'dzin tha dad la brgyud pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje la rgyal po dzas zhus pa/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ sras shākya bhū ti/ ku ku rā dza/ nā gā rdzu na/ pad+ma sam bha wa/ bi ma la mi tra'o/ / gsum pa ni/ / gnyags ku mā ra/ rma rin chen mchog /kye re mchog skyong*/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes/ spa gor blon chen 'phags/ dan yon tan mchog /begs gsal ba'i byang chub/ rgya blo gros gzhon nu/ 'gar tshul khrims bzang po/ mtshur ye shes dbang po/ dan chos kyi dbang phyug zhang mchog gi bla ma/ kyi yon tan 'byung gnas/
